node.title: Re^6: Error codes vs die exceptions vs ...

node.doctext: There are Perl modules that attempt to provide such a mechanism, at least [mod://TryCatch] and [mod://Syntax::Feature::Try] (I only say "attempt" because I haven't tested them myself). See also [mod://Task::Kensho::Exceptions] and [mod://Exception::Class].
